23764-the-bramble-bush.title: The Bramble Bush
23764-the-bramble-bush.creator: Randall Garrett
23764-the-bramble-bush.description: A book by Randall Garrett. The only thing that wasn't as it should be was the picture on the wall. It was a reproduction of a painting by Pieter de Hooch, which he had always liked, aside from the fact that he had been named after the seventeenth-century Dutch artist. The picture was slightly askew on the wall.

arxiv-1401-5284.title: FEATURES OF ULTRASOUND ABSORPTION BY DISLOCATIONS IN SUBGRAIN-FREE Cd 0.2 Hg 0.8 Te CRYSTALS
arxiv-1401-5284.creator: I.O. Lysyuk, Ya.M. Olikh, O.Ya. Olikh, G.V. Beketov
arxiv-1401-5284.description: Abstract The temperature dependence of the ultrasound wave absorption in bulk p p -Cd 0.2 Hg 0.8 Te crystals free from low-angle grain boundaries has been studied experimentally for the first time in the frequency range 10–55 MHz and the temperature interval 150–300 K, and the corresponding results of measurements are presented.

arxiv-2101-06052.title: Chance constrained sets approximation: A probabilistic scaling approach - EXTENDED VERSION
arxiv-2101-06052.creator: M. Mammarella, V. Mirasierra, M. Lorenzen, T. Alamo, F. Dabbene
arxiv-2101-06052.description: Abstract In this paper, a sample-based procedure for obtaining simple and computable approximations of chance-contrained sets is proposed. The procedure allows to control the complexity of the approximating set, by defining families of simple-approximating sets of given complexity. A probabilistic scaling procedure then allows to rescale these sets to obtain the desired probabilistic guarantees.

arxiv-2102-05119.title: Charged dust solutions for the warp drive spacetime
arxiv-2102-05119.creator: Osvaldo L. Santos-Pereira, Everton M. C. Abreu, Marcelo B. Ribeiro
arxiv-2102-05119.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Osvaldo L. Santos-Pereira, Everton M. C. Abreu, Marcelo B. Ribeiro. The Alcubierre warp drive metric is a spacetime construction where a massive particle located inside a spacetime distortion, called warp bubble, travels at velocities arbitrarily higher than the velocity of light. This theoretically constructed spacetime geometry is a consequence of general relativity where global superluminal velocities, also known as warp speeds, are possible, whereas local speeds are limited to subluminal ones as required by special relativity.

arxiv-2107-07718.title: Continuous control of classical-quantum crossover by external high pressure in the coupled chain compound CsCuCl 3
arxiv-2107-07718.creator: Daisuke Yamamoto 1,2, Takahiro Sakurai 3, Ryosuke Okuto 4, Susumu Okubo 5, Hitoshi Ohta 5, Hidekazu Tanaka 6, Yoshiya Uwatoko 7
arxiv-2107-07718.description: Abstract Abstract In solid materials, the parameters relevant to quantum effects, such as the spin quantum number, are basically determined and fixed at the chemical synthesis, which makes it challenging to control the amount of quantum correlations. We propose and demonstrate a method for active control of the classical-quantum crossover in magnetic insulators by applying external pressure.

arxiv-2108-06031.title: Multimodal Unrolled Robust PCA for Background Foreground Separation
arxiv-2108-06031.creator: Spencer Markowitz, Corey Snyder, Yonina C. Eldar, Minh N. Do
arxiv-2108-06031.description: Abstract Background foreground separation (BFS) is a popular computer vision problem where dynamic foreground objects are separated from the static background of a scene. Typically, this is performed using consumer cameras because of their low cost, human interpretability, and high resolution.

arxiv-2209-15059.title: Provably expressive temporal graph networks
arxiv-2209-15059.creator: Amauri H. Souza, Diego Mesquita, Samuel Kaski, Vikas Garg
arxiv-2209-15059.description: Abstract Temporal graph networks (TGNs) have gained prominence as models for embedding dynamic interactions, but little is known about their theoretical underpinnings. We establish fundamental results about the representational power and limits of the two main categories of TGNs: those that aggregate temporal walks (WA-TGNs), and those that augment local message passing with recurrent memory modules (MP-TGNs).

arxiv-2210-15875.title: Dynamic Event − - Triggered Discrete − - Time Linear Time − - Varying System with Privacy − - Preservation
arxiv-2210-15875.creator: Xuefeng Yang, Li Liu, Wenju Zhou, Jing Shi, Yinggang Zhang, Xin Hu, Huiyu Zhou
arxiv-2210-15875.description: Abstract This paper focuses on discrete-time wireless sensor networks with privacy-preservation. In practical applications, information exchange between sensors is subject to attacks. For the information leakage caused by the attack during the information transmission process, privacy-preservation is introduced for system states. To make communication resources more effectively utilized, a dynamic event-triggered set-membership estimator is designed.

arxiv-2305-14501.title: Forward and hybrid path-integral methods in photoelectron holography: sub-barrier corrections, initial sampling and momentum mapping
arxiv-2305-14501.creator: L. Cruz Rodriguez 1 , T. Rook 1 , B.B. Augstein 1 , A.S. Maxwell 1,2 and C. Figueira de Morisson Faria 1
arxiv-2305-14501.description: Abstract We construct two strong-field path integral methods with full Coulomb distortion, in which the quantum pathways are mimicked by interfering electron orbits: the rate-based CQSFA (R-CQSFA) and the hybrid forward-boundary CQSFA (H-CQSFA). The methods have the same starting point as the standard Coulomb quantum-orbit strong-field approximation (CQSFA), but their implementation does not require pre-knowledge of the orbits’ dynamics.

arxiv-2405-04345.title: Novel View Synthesis with Neural Radiance Fields for Industrial Robot Applications
arxiv-2405-04345.creator: Robert Langendörfer 1, Max Heiken 2, Max Mehltretter 2, Andreas Schenk 1, Martin Weinmann 1, Stefan Hinz 1, Christian Heipke 2, Markus Ulrich 1
arxiv-2405-04345.description: Abstract Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have become a rapidly growing research field with the potential to revolutionize typical photogrammetric workflows, such as those used for 3D scene reconstruction. As input, NeRFs require multi-view images with corresponding camera poses as well as the interior orientation.

arxiv-2408-16758.title: Hypergraph saturation for the bow tie
arxiv-2408-16758.creator: Stijn Cambie, Nika Salia
arxiv-2408-16758.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stijn Cambie, Nika Salia. Erdős and Sós initiated the study of the maximum size of a k k -uniform set system, for k ≥ 4 k\geq 4 , with no singleton intersections 50 50 years ago. In this work, we investigate the dual problem: finding the minimum size of a k k -uniform hypergraph with no singleton intersections, such that adding any missing hyperedge forces a singleton intersection. These problems, known as saturation and semi-saturation, are typically challenging.

arxiv-2408-17050.title: Secure Integrated Sensing and Communication Under Correlated Rayleigh Fading
arxiv-2408-17050.creator: Martin Mittelbach 1 , Rafael F. Schaefer 1 , Matthieu Bloch 2 , Aylin Yener 3 , and Onur Günlü 4
arxiv-2408-17050.description: Abstract We consider a secure integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) scenario, in which a signal is transmitted through a state-dependent wiretap channel with one legitimate receiver with which the transmitter communicates and one honest-but-curious target that the transmitter wants to sense.

arxiv-2503-15573.title: Task-Specific Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Monosemantic Neuronal Activations
arxiv-2503-15573.creator: Da Ma, Gonghu Shang, Zhi Chen, Libo Qin, Yijie Luo, Lei Pan, Shuai Fan, Lu Chen, Kai Yu
arxiv-2503-15573.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Da Ma, Gonghu Shang, Zhi Chen, Libo Qin, Yijie Luo, Lei Pan, Shuai Fan, Lu Chen, Kai Yu. Instruction tuning improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to follow diverse human instructions, but achieving strong performance on specific target tasks remains challenging. A critical bottleneck is selecting the most relevant data to maximize task-specific performance. Existing data selection approaches include unstable influence-based methods and more stable distribution alignment methods, the latter of which critically rely on the underlying sample representation.

arxiv-2510-23811.title: ℕ d \mathbb{N}^{d} -indexed persistence modules, higher dimensional partitions and rank invariants
arxiv-2510-23811.creator: Mehdi Nategh, Zhenbo Qin, Shuguang Wang
arxiv-2510-23811.description: Abstract . We study decomposable ℕ d \mathbb{N}^{d} -indexed persistence modules via higher dimensional partitions. Their barcodes are defined in terms of the extended interior of the corresponding Young diagrams. For two decomposable ℕ d \mathbb{N}^{d} -indexed persistence modules, we present a necessary and sufficient condition, in terms of the partitions, for their rank invariants to be the same.

pmc-10755747.title: Dielectric Screening and Charge-Transfer in 2D Lead-Halide Perovskites for Reduced Exciton Binding Energies
pmc-10755747.creator: Aaron Forde, Sergei Tretiak, Amanda J Neukirch
pmc-10755747.description: Layered lead-halide perovskites have shown tremendous success as an active material for optoelectronics. This is attributed to the electronic structure of the inorganic sublattice and large exciton binding energies due to quantum and dielectric confinement. Expanding functionalities for applications that depend on free-carrier generation requires new material design routes to decrease the binding energy.

pmc-11444200.title: In Vitro Evaluation of Antipseudomonal Activity and Safety Profile of Peptidomimetic Furin Inhibitors
pmc-11444200.creator: Sara Maluck, Rivka Bobrovsky, Miklós Poór, Roman W. Lange, Torsten Steinmetzer, Ákos Jerzsele, András Adorján, Dávid Bajusz, Anita Rácz, Erzsébet Pászti-Gere
pmc-11444200.description: Inhibitors of the serine protease furin have been widely studied as antimicrobial agents due to their ability to block the cleavage and activation of certain viral surface proteins and bacterial toxins. In this study, the antipseudomonal effects and safety profiles of the furin inhibitors MI-1851 and MI-2415 were assessed.

pmc-11976080.title: The effect of different pretreatments and cleaning methods prior to adhesive cementation of lithium disilicate restorations. In vitro study
pmc-11976080.creator: Abdulmajeed O Alotaibi, Ahmad Alghamdi, Hatem Alshammari, Christel Larsson, Evaggelia Papia
pmc-11976080.description: AimThis study aimed to evaluate the bond strength of adhesively cemented lithium disilicate restorations to dentin by applying different pretreatments and cleaning methods.Material and MethodsTwenty-five human posterior teeth were mounted in an acrylic mold, flattened to expose mid-coronal dentin, and divided into five groups based on different pretreatments and cleaning methods prior to adhesive cementation.

pmc-12603280.title: Distinct autoreactive CD19– plasma cell subsets accumulate in lupus-prone mice
pmc-12603280.creator: Van Duc Dang, Franziska Szelinski, Elodie Mohr, Tuan Anh Le, Jacob Ritter, Annika Wiedemann, Marta Ferreira-Gomes, Gabriela Maria Guerra, Pawel Durek, Frederik Heinrich, Hector Rincon-Arevalo, Ana-Luisa Stefanski, Eva Schrezenmeier, Van T. Hoang, Hong-Nhung Dao, Soeren Ocvirk, Qingyu Cheng, Falk Hie
pmc-12603280.description: Plasma cells (PC) participate in the pathogenesis of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) through sustained autoantibody and inflammatory cytokine secretion. Current PC-depleting therapies risk eliminating protective long-lived PCs, highlighting the need to identify pathogenic subsets for selective targeting. Here, using single-cell RNA sequencing, B cell receptor repertoire analysis, and genetic models, we identify disease- and organ-specific PCs in lupus-prone mice.

pmc-12675429.title: Long-term athlete development in schools: a systematic review and narrative synthesis
pmc-12675429.creator: Nele Söker, Jasper Schamerowski, Astrid Zech, Simon Steib, Lina Rahlf
pmc-12675429.description: IntroductionEvidence systematically assessing the effects of sports schools on long-term athlete development is largely lacking. In general, sport schools play an increasingly important role in the development of new Olympic and top athletes. Additionally, talent programmes for the context of schools are a strategy for identifying and developing talent in sport.

pmc-12933178.title: Analyses of ATP7B mRNA in Nasopharyngeal Swab Samples Increase Yields of Wilson Disease Molecular Genetic Diagnostics
pmc-12933178.creator: Lenka Steiner Mrázová, Alena Vrbacká, Filip Majer, Viktor Stránecký, Lenka Nosková, Daniela Záhoráková, Jitka Májovská, Ibrahim Bitar, Jiří Klempíř, Jana Šaligová, Stella Majlingová, Mária Giertlová, Petra Drenčáková, Denisa Harvanová, Pavla Solařová, Radan Brůha, Petr Dušek, Stanislav Kmoch, Jakub
pmc-12933178.description: Wilson disease (WD) is an autosomal recessive disorder of copper transport caused by bi‐allelic pathogenic variants in the ATPase copper transporting beta gene (ATP7B). Results of standard genetic diagnostics remain inconclusive in 3%–20% of WD patients in part due to problematic assessment of variants of unknown or conflicting pathogenicity (synonymous variants included).

pmc-12977189.title: Efficient water electrolysis with Ce-WO3@NiCo bifunctional catalysts
pmc-12977189.creator: Yuan Qin, Meng Ding, Weixiao Ji, Yafang Zhang, Gang Zhao
pmc-12977189.description: The development of highly efficient non-precious metal electrocatalysts with excellent activity and durability for overall water splitting remains a critical challenge for advancing sustainable hydrogen production. In this work, Ce-WO3@NiCo nanoflower architectures are achieved on copper foam (CF) substrates through hydrothermal and electrodeposition methods.

pmc-13280716.title: Combination therapy of pasireotide and pegvisomant for aggressive acromegaly with an immature PIT1-lineage PitNET
pmc-13280716.creator: Keiko Tomiyama, Izumi Fukuda, Shigeyuki Tahara, Chie Inomoto, Robert Yoshiyuki Osamura, Masato Iwabu
pmc-13280716.description: SummaryA 29-year-old male presented with central scotoma and was suspected of having acromegaly based on enlargement of facial features and extremities. Serum growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) levels were elevated to 10.14 ng/mL and 571 ng/mL (74.8 nmol/L, +5.73 SDS), respectively.
